name: 85303 · Glendale, AZ
findings: ZIP 85303 (Glendale) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85303 (Glendale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85303 (Glendale) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
